changeSet.sql: WITH exact_refs AS ( SELECT indicator_id, min(ref_target) target FROM gov_indicator_reference WHERE ref_type = 'MODEL_SPEC_FIELD' GROUP BY indicator_id HAVING count(*) = 1 ) UPDATE gov_indicator_definition i SET implementation_ref = jsonb_build_object( 'modelSpecId', split_part(r.target, '@', 1), 'modelRevision', split_part(split_part(r.target, '@', 2), '#', 1)::integer, 'fieldName', split_part(r.target, '#', 2)) FROM exact_refs r WHERE r.indicator_id = i.id AND r.target ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}@[1-9][0-9]{0,8}#[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$';
